assumptions: The cytobands and RefSeq set for the assembly named.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this window of the genome hold: bands, transcripts and nuclease sites?

description: Read one window of a genome the way a genome browser shows it: the cytogenetic bands it spans, the transcripts in the chosen RefSeq set, which residues of each protein the window encodes (translated from the assembly’s own bases), how many dbSNP 155 variants fall in it and how many ClinVar calls pathogenic, and every CRISPR site for the chosen nuclease (SpCas9 unless told otherwise) with its strand, cut position and on-target scores. Give a gene symbol (resolved through MANE Select, then HGNC) or a locus, 1-based and inclusive. Each lane refuses a window wider than it will read, and says so.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

assembly.description: the UCSC assembly name (hg38, hg19, mm39…).

gene.description: a gene symbol; the window is its MANE Select (or HGNC) transcript with a 2% margin either side. Takes precedence over `locus`.

gene_track.description: which RefSeq set the transcripts and protein residues come from. Values: ncbiRefSeqSelect (RefSeq Select and MANE), ncbiRefSeqCurated (RefSeq Curated), ncbiRefSeq (RefSeq All), ncbiRefSeqPredicted (RefSeq Predicted).

locus.description: the window, 1-based and inclusive, when no `gene` is given.

nuclease.description: which nuclease the CRISPR sites are enumerated for (its PAM and cut rule). On-target scores are SpCas9-trained and come back null for any other. Values: SpCas9 (SpCas9 · NGG), SpCas9-NG (SpCas9-NG · NG), SpG (SpG · NGN), SpRY (SpRY · NRN), xCas9 (xCas9 · NG), SaCas9 (SaCas9 · NNGRRT), SaCas9-KKH (SaCas9-KKH · NNNRRT), AsCas12a (AsCas12a · TTTV), LbCas12a (LbCas12a · TTTV), enAsCas12a (enAsCas12a · TTTV).

name: browse_region

protein.description: per transcript: accession, strand, the first and last residue numbers in the window and the residues themselves

refusals.description: each lane that did not run for this window, and why

sites.description: CRISPR sites: spacer, PAM, strand, 1-based protospacer bounds, cut position and Rule Set 1 / CRISPRscan scores

summary.description: what each lane found in the window, generated from the run

window.description: the window read, 1-based inclusive, and how it was reached
